mentions.name: Local-only social media manager
mentions.description: A local-only social media manager for composing and syncing posts to social networks like Mastodon and Bluesky via their APIs, with data stored locally and a data folder that can be synced manually (e.g. Dropbox or sneakernet) or over a basic cheap data plan. It is initially targeting the game development community.
mentions.problem: Existing social media management platforms such as Buffer and Hootsuite are subscription-only.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been prototyping a local-only social media manager initially targeting the game development community. I am sick of all the subscription only platforms such as buffer, hootsuite etc.

evidence.value: I have been prototyping a local-only social media manager initially targeting the game development community. I am sick of all the subscription only platforms such as buffer, hootsuite etc.
